newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisian beverages firm SFBT H1 net down.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian beverages firm SFBT H1 net down.

text.p: Tunisian beverages firm Societe Frigorifique et Brasserie de Tunis SFBT said net profits for the first half of 1996 fell to 218,443 dinars from 1.894 million dinars during the same period last year.
SFBT, which is the country's only bottler for beer and Coca Cola, posted a 3.231 million dinars net profit in 1995, up from 2.764 million dinars in 1994.
It paid a 2.5 dinar for 1995 at the end of July.
The state-controlled firm has a capital of 9 million dinars.
Its shares were last priced at 146.39 dinars on the Tunis Stock Exchange.
